structured.answer: I didn't decide anything. The page explains what the different kinds are, but it doesn't say what any of them pays or what the bank takes. Government bonds ("איגרות חוב ממשלתיות"), and maybe "מק"מ", are the only things I'd ask my son or the bank clerk about. The English and "מדד" items aren't for me.

stuck.where: Section heading "במה הכסף מושקע" and the "קרן כספית" card
stuck.why: The heading says this is what's inside a product, but the card says it's a "קרן נאמנות", which is a product itself. That made me doubt the whole list.
Every starting point is for salaried workers ("שכירים", "חוסך שכיר"). There was nothing for a retiree with deposits, so I didn't know where to begin.
Not a bank or anything official, so I'm unsure how far to trust it

findings.what: Heading promises "מה שבתוך המוצר" (what's inside a product), but "קרן כספית" is described as a "קרן נאמנות", which is a product itself. That made me distrust the list.
Grey, small text on a black background, hard to read even with glasses
No returns or fees anywhere, so I can't tell if something gives more than my deposit or if the bank takes too much
Many cards with English letters and "מדד". It felt like gambling and not for me.
Starting suggestions are only for salaried workers
A private, non-commercial site, not a bank. I'm not sure whether to trust it.
Unfamiliar terms in the opening explanation (מק"מ, קרן כספית, מדד מניות)
